req.title: Reject player with duplicate squadNumber
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 409 Conflict when the squadNumber in a new player already belongs to another player.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-008 requires HTTP 409 Conflict when a POST /players/ request carries a squadNumber already present in the database. The test suite covers: (1) a positive case confirming a genuinely new squadNumber is accepted with HTTP 201; (2) a negative/EP case confirming an existing squadNumber (e.g. 10 – Messi) returns exactly HTTP 409 with the correct detail message; (3) a boundary/STC case that first creates a player with a fresh squadNumber, then immediately POSTs the same squadNumber again to confirm the transition from 'not-exists' to 'exists' triggers 409; (4) a DT case verifying that only the squadNumber collision matters – all other fields can differ; (5) a BVA case using squadNumber=1 (lowest pre-loaded value) to confirm the duplicate check fires at the boundary of the pre-loaded range. Exact status codes and response body fields are asserted to kill constant-mutation and comparison-flip mutants.

tests.name: test_post_new_squad_number_returns_201
preconditions: squadNumber 99 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with a valid payload using squadNumber=99
expected: Response body contains the created player with squadNumber=99
trace: R-PLAYER-008: system must accept players with non-duplicate squadNumbers
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_new_squad_number_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"
    assert "id" in body
    assert body["id"] is not None

tests.name: test_post_duplicate_squad_number_returns_409
expected: Response body detail contains 'A Player with this squad number already exists.'
trace: R-PLAYER-008: system shall respond with HTTP 409 when squadNumber already belongs to another player

from main import app

tests.name: test_post_same_squad_number_twice_second_returns_409
preconditions: squadNumber 50 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with squadNumber=50 (first time – should succeed)
POST /players/ with squadNumber=50 again (second time – should conflict)
expected: Second POST detail is 'A Player with this squad number already exists.'
trace: R-PLAYER-008: state transition from non-existing to existing squadNumber triggers 409 on second POST
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_same_squad_number_twice_second_returns_409():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "First",
        "lastName": "Insert",
        "squadNumber": 50,
        "position": "Centre-Back"
    }
    r1 = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r1.status_code == 201
    assert r1.json()["squadNumber"] == 50

    payload2 = {
        "firstName": "Second",
        "lastName": "Attempt",
        "squadNumber": 50,
        "position": "Left-Back"
    }
    r2 = client.post("/players/", json=payload2)
    assert r2.status_code == 409
    body2 = r2.json()
    assert body2["detail"] == "A Player with this squad number already exists."

tests.name: test_post_duplicate_squad_number_different_fields_still_409
preconditions: squadNumber 7 belongs to Rodrigo de Paul
actions: POST /players/ with squadNumber=7 but completely different name, position, team, league
expected: HTTP 409 Conflict regardless of other field values
Response detail is exactly 'A Player with this squad number already exists.'
trace: R-PLAYER-008: collision is determined solely by squadNumber; other fields are irrelevant

tests.name: test_post_duplicate_squad_number_boundary_highest_preloaded
preconditions: squadNumber 26 is the highest pre-loaded value (Nahuel Molina)
actions: POST /players/ with squadNumber=26 (boundary maximum of pre-loaded range)
POST /players/ with squadNumber=27 (one above maximum – should succeed)
trace: R-PLAYER-008: duplicate check fires at upper boundary (26) but not at 26+1=27
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_duplicate_squad_number_boundary_highest_preloaded():
    payload_dup = {
        "firstName": "Boundary",
        "lastName": "High",
        "squadNumber": 26,
        "position": "Right-Back"
    }
    r_dup = client.post("/players/", json=payload_dup)
    assert r_dup.status_code == 409
    assert r_dup.json()["detail"] == "A Player with this squad number already exists."

    payload_new = {
        "firstName": "Boundary",
        "lastName": "Above",
        "squadNumber": 27,
        "position": "Right-Back"
    }
    r_new = client.post("/players/", json=payload_new)
    assert r_new.status_code == 201
    assert r_new.json()["squadNumber"] == 27
